name: scenario-testing-workspaces
description: Nested workspace for @scenario-testing packages (install from this directory).

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@scenario-testing/core --if-present && npm run build --workspace=@scenario-testing/react-router --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@scenario-testing/core && npm run test --workspace=@scenario-testing/react-router
